$comment: Prior-art register. These are the target's PUBLISHED advisories. They are prior art: reproduce them (labelled REPRODUCED-KNOWN) to validate the method, NEVER claim them as novel discoveries. A finding labelled CONFIRMED-NOVEL must be absent from this register.
verification_note: Re-scrape the Security > Advisories tab before relying on this; the maintainer publishes new advisories regularly.

advisories.title: Unauthenticated cross-tenant read of all users' alert rules via public Convex query getByEnabled
advisories.class: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) / public-function authz

advisories.title: Windows command injection in Tauri open_url IPC (cmd /c start) - user-assisted desktop RCE
Desktop trusted windows could read the full secret cache and local API token
Abuse-control / rate-limit bypass via spoofable cf-connecting-ip header
MCP daily cost-cap bypass: quota slot refunded after the tool already executed
advisories.note: Matches the Denial-of-Wallet 'Vector B' pattern almost word-for-word: theory plus the target's own published scar.

advisories.title: Slack and Discord OAuth state consumption is non-atomic and fail-open
advisories.note: Direct evidence for the AI-seam thesis: 'non-atomic and fail-open' is the RLHF 'don't crash' pattern.

advisories.title: Generated API runtime validation is disabled
advisories.note: Direct evidence for the AI-seam thesis: the control exists syntactically but is switched off.

advisories.title: Browser sessions can poison shared temporal baselines
Weak (FNV-1a 52-bit) cache key in buildSummaryCacheKey allows unauthenticated poisoning of the shared summary/translation cache
MCP SSE replay is not bound to the authenticated owner
advisories.note: Sits exactly where the NSA MCP security paper predicts (token/session lifecycle unspecified by spec).

advisories.title: OAuth refresh-token reuse not contained: no family revocation on detected reuse
DNS-rebinding residual in the MCP proxy: Vercel Edge fetch cannot pin its socket to the vetted address
advisories.note: Referenced openly in SECURITY.md. External anchor: vercel-labs/guarded-fetch implements the connect-time IP pinning that closes this class.
